task.title: P6-160: Fix /my root's duplicate nav label and unlabeled skeleton div
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-160. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`/my` root has two a11y wiring errors** (was `P6-021d` + `P6-021e`): `<nav aria-label="My cards">` (`root.rs:267`) duplicates the accessible name of the bottom tab bar's `My cards` link in the same document (`shell.rs:522`) — "Collections" or `aria-labelledby` off the heading would be distinct; and `list_skeleton` puts `aria-busy` and `aria-label` on a plain `<div>` with no role (`root.rs:254-257`), so the label has nothing to attach to.
